title: Add your first household and start planning
summary: Add a household from Clients, start their plan with the Guided Walkthrough, and see what a finished plan looks like.

chapters.label: Here's how to add your first household and start their plan.
Open Clients from the sidebar, then select New household.
Enter the client's name and date of birth.
Planning for a couple? Check Add Co-client and enter their details.
Pick their state. It sets their state income and estate tax.
The name fills in on its own. Then select Create household.
Next, choose how to start their plan. There are four ways.
Guided Walkthrough takes you through their plan one step at a time.
AI import reads their statements and builds the plan from them.
Intake form emails them a questionnaire to fill in.
Empty client starts blank, so you fill it in as you go.
Pick Guided Walkthrough, then select Start guided walkthrough.
The walkthrough builds their plan in nine steps.
First the household and their family: names, ages, children.
Then what they own and owe: accounts, home, mortgages and loans.
Then goals, income and expenses, insurance, and planning assumptions.
Skip any step for now. Review shows what's done and what's left.
Back in Clients, Mark and Laura Hendricks already have a full plan.
CRM opens their record: contacts, tasks, notes and documents.
Planning opens their plan.
The bar across the top moves between Details, Solver and Presentations.
Open the Solver. It's where you view and build the plan.
Finish the walkthrough, and Ben and Claire's plan looks like this.

steps: **Open Clients.** Select **Clients** in the sidebar, then **New household**.
**Enter the people.** Fill in **First name**, **Last name** and **Date of birth**. For a couple, check **Add Co-client** and enter their details.
**Pick the state and create it.** Choose a **State of residence**, which sets state income and estate tax. The **Household name** fills in on its own. Select **Create household**.
**Choose how to start their plan.** **Guided Walkthrough**, **AI import** (reads their statements), **Intake form** (emails them a questionnaire) or **Empty client**.
**Start the walkthrough.** Pick **Guided Walkthrough**. Retirement age, month, life expectancy and filing status start with defaults you can change. Select **Start guided walkthrough**.

**Work through the nine steps.** Household and Family, then Assets and Liabilities, then Goals, Cash Flow, Insurance and Assumptions. **Next** moves on; a step you pass without entering anything is marked skipped. **Review** shows what's complete, skipped and remaining.
**Open a household from Clients.** **CRM** opens their record: contacts, tasks, notes and documents. **Planning** opens their plan.
**Find your way around the plan.** The bar across the top moves between **Details**, **Solver** and **Presentations**, plus the **Assets**, **Cash Flow** and **Estate** menus.
**Open the Solver.** It's where you view and build the plan. A finished plan shows its projection and key figures.
goodToKnow: **Save & exit** leaves the walkthrough. Reopen it from **Guided Walkthrough** on the plan's Details page.
Not ready to plan yet? Select **Not now** after creating the household. You can start planning later from its CRM record.
Clients opens on **Recently opened**. Choose **All** to see every household.
